During the year the Company acquired the business operations of Maharaja Supermarket (Private) Limited, a related party, with
effect from 1st July 2025 and the business operations of its wholly owned subsidiary, Maharaja Marketing (Private) Limited, with
effect from 1st September 2025. The wholesale distribution and retail supermarket activities of the Group are now carried on by the
Company. Further particulars are given in Note 29 - Transfer of Business Operations. Other than as stated above, there were no
signicant changes in the nature of the principal business activities of the Group during the nancial year under review.
1.3 Parent Entity and Subsidiary
The Company holds the entire issued share capital of Maharaja Marketing (Private) Limited, which is accordingly a subsidiary of the
Company and is consolidated in these nancial statements. The Company also holds 10,000 ordinary shares, representing 9% of
the issued share capital, of Maharaja Supermarket (Private) Limited, which is not controlled by the Group and is not consolidated.
1.4 Parent Undertaking and Ultimate Controlling Party
The immediate and ultimate parent undertaking of the Company is GTV Global Holdings (Private) Limited, a company incorporated in
Sri Lanka, which holds 87,912,115 ordinary shares representing 63.94% of the issued share capital of the Company as at the
reporting date. GTV Global Holdings (Private) Limited is wholly owned by Mrs. Thavamalar Guganathan, Mr. Guganathan
Vijayananth and Mr. Guganathan Vithyanath, who are respectively the Executive Director, the Chairman and the Managing Director of
the Company.

2.2 Basis of Consolidation
These nancial statements are prepared on a consolidated basis, incorporating the nancial statements of Maharaja Foods PLC
("the Parent" or "the Company") and its wholly owned subsidiary, Maharaja Marketing (Private) Limited ("the Subsidiary"), made up
to 31st March 2026. The detailed policy applied in preparing the Consolidated Financial Statements is set out in policy 3.2.
The control relationship between the Parent and the Subsidiary was established through an agreement entered into by the common
shareholders of both companies on 31st March 2023, under which the Parent exercises controlling power over the nancial and
operating policies of the Subsidiary. During the year ended 31st March 2025 all shares of the Subsidiary previously held by individual
shareholders were transferred to the Parent, and the Parent has since held 100% of the issued share capital of the Subsidiary.
Accordingly, there is no non-controlling interest in the Group at the reporting date (2025: Nil).
2.3 Basis of Measurement
The Consolidated Financial Statements have been prepared on the historical cost basis, except for property, plant and equipment of
the Company, which is measured at revalued amounts. The Subsidiary has never revalued its assets and holds no property, plant

Rs. 591,371 recognised by the Subsidiary on the transfer of its property, plant and equipment have been eliminated, and the assets
concerned are carried in the consolidated statement of nancial position at their carrying amounts to the Group before the transfer.
The investment of the Company in the Subsidiary is eliminated against the equity of the Subsidiary.
c) Non-Controlling Interests and Loss of Control
Non-controlling interests are presented separately within equity where they arise. The Subsidiary is wholly owned and there is no
non-controlling interest at the reporting date. When the Group loses control of a subsidiary, it derecognises the assets and liabilities
of that subsidiary and any related non-controlling interest, and any resulting gain or loss is recognised in prot or loss.
d) Discontinued Operations

(e) Related Party Status
Both transfers were transactions with related parties. Maharaja Marketing (Private) Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of
the Company. Maharaja Supermarket (Private) Limited is an entity in which the Company holds a 9% equity interest and in
which Mrs. Thavamalar Guganathan, Mr. Guganathan Vijayananth and Mr. Guganathan Vithyanath — who are respectively
the Executive Director, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company — together hold 91% of the issued share capital.
Further particulars of transactions and balances with related parties are given in Note 30.
